verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a built-in, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants work with its error, performance and log data. A dedicated docs page lists concrete tools, such as browsing issues, inspecting stack traces, resolving issues and detect_n_plus_one, and a probe confirmed that docs page exists. Missing for 10: documented connection/auth setup steps for agents in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
